heard: The chief priests met with the Pharisees They sat in council and asked with care What are we doing? They questioned deep This man performs many signs, they said If he keeps on like this, they feared Everyone will believe in him The Romans will come to take away Both our place and our nation It is better that one man die For the people than the whole nation perish One man die for the people Save us from the end of days One of them named Caiaphas
